name: barbell olympic squat
description: A deep, upright high-bar squat in the weightlifting style. It builds leg strength and mobility.
instructions: Place the bar high on your upper back and set your feet about shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit straight down as deep as you can with heels flat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
